Population increased in East Sussex

The estimated population of East Sussex in 2024 was 560,882 usual residents, a rise of 0.8% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of East Sussex increased by 2.6%.

Age profile of East Sussex

The average (median) age fell to 48.4 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of East Sussex has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, East Sussex's population of 560,882 usual residents was made up of:

  • 91,307 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.3%)
  • 320,160 people aged 16 to 64 years, (57.1%)
  • 149,415 people aged 65 years and over, (26.6%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, East Sussex has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (26.6% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In East Sussex, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in East Sussex
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for East Sussex, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 2,552 people (-0.5%). In total, there were 4,365 births and 6,917 deaths in East Sussex.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 3,988 (0.7%). There were 23,596 people entering the area and 19,608 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in East Sussex's population of 2,851 (0.5%) as a result of 4,589 people entering the area and 1,738 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for East Sussex was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of East Sussex in mid-2023 is 556,638.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 1,320 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 166 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 1,154 people.
